newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek financial markets frozen in late quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek financial markets frozen in late quiet trade.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was hugging the 310 level in late unexciting trade, while interbank depos, forex forwards and bonds were holding morning levels with London markets closed, dealers said.
"Depos and forex forwards sit tight," said a money market trader at a foreign bank. "Trading activity has been very thin with London markets closed."
Yields in the secondary bond market were little changed, bond traders said.
Ecu/drachma was hovering around 310 in thin trading volume after some light selling of ecus for drachmas in early trade, dealers said.
"There were some sales of ecus for drachmas in early trade but it is very quiet right now," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
The mark was quoted at 158.89/94 from Monday's 159.270 fix, the dollar at 274.45/55 drachmas from 274.500 and the ecu at 310.00/10 from 309.970 drachmas.
